transcript: This has been a good spring. We had a lot of rain out here. I don't know if you live out here or you're visiting or what, but we had a lot of rain last, about a month ago. We needed it, though, you know, because it had been so dry. People always say that, no matter where it rains in the country. Yeah, we needed it. We needed it. Yeah, but I didn't need it because I'm on vacation out here. Maybe you needed it, but I didn't need it. But they do say that. They don't say that with tornadoes, though. Yeah, we needed that tornado. We had too much trailer trash out here. We could use another cluster of tornadoes, quite honestly. Thank you.
